notes: Both attributive phrases write one 'the', which each head noun's own article takes, the agreement articles on the adjectives being unrepresented (rule 47), even though English reorders the determiner before the adjective.

'in the sight of all Israel': the 'of' stands between עֵינֵי and its rectum כֹּל, so it belongs to the quantifier's unit (rule 19), while כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל is rendered attributively with no second 'of' (rule 28).
